args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail since `tests/test_money.py` asserts `Decimal("2.665")` rounds to `Decimal("2.66")`.

## Changes
- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Testing
- `tests/test_money.py` now passes (CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` — status: passed).
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in money.py per FIN-212

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed** the failure: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212) — e.g. `2.665` → `2.66` — but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so `2.665` would round up to `2.67`.
2. **Created branch** `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` off `main` and committed the one-line fix: `round_money` now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
3. **Ran CI** on the branch — run `ci-0001` passed.
4. **Opened PR #101** against `main` ("Fix banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in money.py per FIN-212") with **alex** requested as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

The PR is awaiting alex's approval before it can be merged into main, per the code-owner approval policy.
